model.architecture: YOLO11n-seg + P2/4 + multi-scale PANet + boundary loss

conclusion: The first-round P2/multi-scale/boundary variant did not beat the baseline under the 12-epoch subset budget. It is retained as an experimental V1 artifact; the production V2 freeze uses the higher-accuracy V5 segmentation model.
recommendation: Warm-start from a compatible segmentation checkpoint instead of transferring only generic YOLO weights.
Train P2/P3 levels with longer schedules and class-balanced sampling.
Use boundary loss as a fine-tuning term after the detector has converged.
